items.description: White Box is a network equipment delivery model in which the hardware platform and network software are delivered separately. White Box emerged as a response to classic network hardware and software systems (HSS) from well-known vendors, which are typically black boxes.

The hardware platform and network software for the White Box model are supplied separately, allowing you to assemble your own combination of elements, replace any component independently of others, or even modify the OS for your specific tasks. This approach ensures transparent pricing, saves on infrastructure costs, and reduces dependence on large network solution providers.

items.title: Economic Efficiency
items.text: White Box is not just a switch without being tied to a specific operating system. It is a multiservice network platform that allows you to ensure the operation of all necessary functions. Such a solution is easy to scale with business growth, and the independence of the software part from the hardware allows you to flexibly configure the services required by a specific company and use them to the maximum.

items.title: What problems does White Box help solve?
items.description: For example, a company has a whole network of small offices. Each location needs network access, which is provided by a switch. But in addition to this, Wi-Fi, telephony, and the collection of information from various sensors and video cameras may also be required. The cost of implementing the entire set of these IT functions should be as low as possible, while a centralized approach should be implemented everywhere. In this case, White Box helps—it allows you to implement all these functions on a single IT platform. And by implementing monitoring and management agents, you can get the most informative system possible.

White Box is a composite product, so it is not always clear who to turn to for help at different stages of implementation and when problems arise. A large IT integrator plays the role of a center of expertise here: it helps to conduct detailed testing of the solution, performs all turnkey work, and provides long-term support.
The more experience an integrator has in building data centers using various network solutions, the better the quality of White Box implementation and subsequent operation they can ensure.

«Infosystem Jet» has a special laboratory for testing White Box solutions, where we have already tested Edgecore, Asterfusion, and Ufispace switches. All models were used in the construction of real data centers in Russia, which gives us, as an integrator, an understanding of all the nuances of working with them.

We are ready to offer our assistance in all aspects: from selecting a suitable solution, developing a working project, equipment delivery and implementation, to the subsequent development of data center network automation systems and support for the final solution. We are also ready to provide training and consultations to end customers on white-box products.

data.description:
Hybrid cloud combines a company's IT resources with the infrastructure and services of third-party public cloud providers. The hybrid cloud model allows flexible distribution of IT services depending on their criticality — with a hybrid cloud, data can be stored and applications run in multiple environments. At the same time, the hybrid cloud environment allows centralized management of all computing resources.

Strategically, the hybrid cloud enables faster adaptation to changing market conditions and flexible scaling in accordance with business goals. Most importantly, the hybrid cloud combines the advantages of two approaches: on-premise and cloud. Constant or specific loads are more efficiently kept in-house, while variable loads are moved to the cloud. The virtual environment allows rapid system deployment regardless of equipment delivery times and significantly reduces Time to Market.
